name: Ipoh
registryBasis: The Ipoh District and Land Office e-Tanah page documents the local land office and online services, and Ipoh City Council’s GIS page describes geospatial attribute-table data for the whole Ipoh area. The GIS page requires login; no anonymous cadastral layer or parcel-vector schema was verified.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: Local land-office services and a city GIS portal are verified, but the GIS portal is login-gated. No anonymous full-polygon endpoint, safe field schema, or complete citywide cadastral coverage was verified.
scopeLimits: Source discovery only. Official evidence confirms local registry/land-record services only where stated in registryBasis; it does not establish complete citywide cadastral coverage or parcel geometry at the WUP point. No owner, address, tax, personal-identity, credential or account lookup was submitted or retained. No parcel geometry or feature attributes were retained.
